profile_text.body:
Submagic is a short-form video editing tool whose site describes it as a way to edit shorts 10x faster with AI. According to the company, a user uploads a video and the software automatically detects highlights, adds captions, and formats the clip for short-form platforms, after which the result can be edited like text and exported in minutes. The site presents the product as making short-form videos captivating with AI captions, b-rolls, and smart edits, and as a way to save time and grow social media reach.

The site lists a set of named tools around that core: an Auto Subtitle Generator, Add Subtitles to Videos, an AI Video Editor, Video To Text, AI Podcast Clip, AI Caption Generator, AI B-Roll Generator, AI Auto-Zoom, AI Sound Effects, and AI Video Translator. It also offers creator utilities including thumbnails, video script and video hook tools, TikTok hashtags and caption generators, AI video ideas, and Instagram caption and username generators.

The held record describes Submagic as an auto-caption AI product covering video subtitles and emoji and sticker automation, and identifies it as an EU vendor. No litigation, MCP server, SEC, or patent facts are present for the company.
